body: I think we should also change `<optgroup>.label` so it actually reflects the `legend` element when there is one. Seems quite strange the API would not reflect all of this. But that's probably a separate change at this point with its own tests.

This looks better. We also discovered that `display: block` for `option` and `optgroup` is universal and not restricted to having a `select` ancestor. Should we make those changes as part of this? And `optgroup` has `font-weight: bolder` iirc.
